title: D1-D5 CFT data from $AdS_3 \times S^3$ Virasoro-Shapiro amplitude
summary: The AdS Virasoro-Shapiro amplitude has recently been generalized to the AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ correspondence between type IIB string theory on $ AdS_3 \times S^3 \times K3$ (or $T^4$), supported by Ramond-Ramond flux, and the D1-D5 CFT. In this paper, we use the $ AdS\times S$ Virasoro-Shapiro machinery to extract strong-coupling CFT data of the D1-D5 CFT by extending and completing earlier analyses in several directions.
